attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Idaho corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or doing business in Idaho.

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus or doing business threshold; result.id_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.id_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus or doing business - filing required

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Idaho state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. ID requires addback of state taxes deducted federally and allows subtraction of U.S. government interest.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Idaho state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set result.id_state_additions = 0.0; if result.id_state_taxes_deducted != 0.0 then set result.id_state_additions = result.id_state_additions + result.id_state_taxes_deducted; endif set result.id_state_subtractions = 0.0; if result.id_us_interest_income != 0.0 then set result.id_state_subtractions = result.id_state_subtractions + result.id_us_interest_income; endif if result.id_municipal_interest != 0.0 then set result.id_state_subtractions = result.id_state_subtractions + result.id_municipal_interest; endif add (("Idaho additions: $" + string value of (result.id_state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (result.id_state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.id_state_additions xdef { result.id_state_additions result.id_state_taxes_deducted f+ cvd /result.id_state_additions xdef } {} result.id_state_taxes_deducted 0.0 f== not ifelse 0.0 cvd /result.id_state_subtractions xdef { result.id_state_subtractions result.id_us_interest_income f+ cvd /result.id_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.id_us_interest_income 0.0 f== not ifelse { result.id_state_subtractions result.id_municipal_interest f+ cvd /result.id_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.id_municipal_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse "Idaho additions: $" result.id_state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat result.id_state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Idaho corporate income tax. Applies Idaho flat rate (5.3%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.id_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Idaho corporate tax (flat rate 5.3%); Apply Idaho 5.3% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set result.id_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.id_apportioned_income + result.id_state_additions - result.id_state_subtractions) and (0.0); set result.id_tax_liability = the maximum of (result.id_taxable_income * result.id_corp_tax_rate - result.id_state_credits) and (0.0); set result.id_refund_or_owed = result.id_estimated_payments - result.id_tax_liability; add "Idaho taxable income: $" + string value of (result.id_taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Idaho tax liability (5.3%): $" + string value of (result.id_tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: result.id_apportioned_income result.id_state_additions f+ result.id_state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.id_taxable_income xdef result.id_taxable_income result.id_corp_tax_rate fmul result.id_state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.id_tax_liability xdef result.id_estimated_payments result.id_tax_liability f- cvd /result.id_refund_or_owed xdef "Idaho taxable income: $" result.id_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Idaho tax liability (5.3%): $" result.id_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
